Game Overview

Revenge and Justice Third Person is a shooter title where step into 2050’s sun-baked wastelands as Salvador, on a mission of vengeance. Master survival with cunning and skill in a world where silence matters as much as gunshots. Strategically navigate oppressive ruins, utilizing your environment and crossbow to outsmart merciless foes and uncover hidden truths.
